convert_nemo_to_hf_weights: convert a NeMo Nemotron checkpoint to HuggingFace weights saved as pytorch_model.bin
generate_hf_model_folder: generate a full HuggingFace model folder with config and tokenizer from a NeMo checkpoint
convert_hf_config: convert NeMo model configuration to HuggingFace config.json format
extract_nemotron_tokenizer: extract and convert a NeMo tokenizer to HuggingFace tokenizer format
run_conversion_cli: run the CLI conversion script with argparse to convert NeMo Nemotron to HuggingFace
